Masking exactly one occurrence per literal exempts the span the manifest vouches for and nothing else -- 'Click Delete in the Editor window, then delete all records.' Not adopted: 'permit original spellings inside verification callouts'. Evidence: canonicalize_terms is a pure per-token regex substitution applied identically to every string in `fields` (consistency.py:283-293, pattern.sub over each field), so passing the claim texts in the same call keeps claims, placed text and narrative in lockstep and no claim is uncovered by a spelling merge -- the post-canonicalization ensure_claim_coverage is then a safety net that is expected to append nothing.
